_comment: Target sites on the Moon and Mars, transcribed from the team research document. Rules: no value without a source_id; missing = null + status TODO; conflicts carry the flag 'inconsistent_in_docs'. 'features' hold the values the score compares against; 'facts' are context shown in the UI but not scored. Measurement fields: value | min+max (range target), unit, status (verified|verify|TODO|derived|method), source_id, confidence (high|medium|low), flags[], note.

position.note: Crater centre (86.9°S, 4°W) from the team docs. The LROC NAC ROI centre (NAC_ROI_HAWORTH_LOB) is −86.7°, 336.3°E (= −23.7°). Team decision 1: use one convention for all nine Artemis targets.

slope_deg.note: Not in team docs. Extract from LOLA slope maps.

rock_cover_pct.note: Boulder count and density not found.

regolith_type.note: General lunar regolith; PSR soil described as highly porous.

geology_type.note: Mineral composition (rock type) not found in team docs.

psr_mean_annual_max_K.note: Mean annual maximum temperature of the nearby Haworth permanently shadowed region (team document, citing Hayne et al. 2015). Describes the PSR, not the whole region, and is not a temperature swing. Not re-checked by the assistant: the paper's server has a broken TLS certificate chain.

cold_index.note: Target = the coldest Earth candidate. PSR temperatures (~60–80 K annual max) cannot be matched on Earth.

max_sun_elev_deg.note: 90° − 86.9° + 1.54° (lunar equator tilt to ecliptic) at the crater centre. Crater floor is mostly in permanent shadow.

ice_presence.note: UV off/on-band ratio 1.32 is above the 1.2 ice threshold (surface frost). Ice mixed in soil ~0.1–2 wt% (all cold traps combined).

ice_depth_m.note: Neutron data only senses the top ~1 m; no depth to ice reported.

logistics_index.note: Earth-only factor: target is the most accessible site.
